title: 10 Hard SAT Reading & Writing Questions to Try Before December 5
description:
Taking the SAT on December 5? Try these 10 hard SAT-style Reading and Writing questions first. Pause before each answer, keep score, and use the breakdown at the end to see which domain to review.

Covered:
• Words in context, overall structure, and a two-text (cross-text) question
• A data question with a graph, evidence from a poem, and the hardest inference
• Semicolons in a complex list and finding the main verb
• A transition question and a notes (rhetorical synthesis) question

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. Graph data in Question 3 is illustrative (made up for practice). For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank.
